spans.s: -bhṛkuṭika, ifc. Bhvr. (Skt. ˚ṭī plus -ka; cf. Pali bhākuṭika), frown: vyapagata-˚kā (f.) LV 〔26.22〕; ˚kaḥ 〔118.17〕; cf. -bhrūkuṭika.
bhṛkuṭīka, adj. (cf. Pali bhākuṭika, adj., and -bhṛkuṭika), frowning: in RP 〔31.2〕 (vs) read āvāsagṛdhra (= ˚rāḥ) ˚kās (n. pl. m.).
Bhṛkuṭinī (cf. next), n. of an attendant on the four direction-rulers: Mahāsamāj. Waldschmidt, Kl. Skt. Texte 4, 〔173.10〕.
Bhṛkuṭī, n. of a goddess (= Ārya-Bhṛ˚, q.v.), regularly associated with Hayagrīva: Sādh 〔37.9〕 etc.
